organization.name: The Rocket Science Group LLC (Mailchimp)
organization.notes: Founded2001; Intuit completed acquisition November2021. No historical equity investor named in checked primary announcement; external secondary sources describe bootstrapping but primary confirmation not established, so funding unknown. Parent ownership distinct from startup funding.

pricingTiers.name: Essentials
pricingTiers.notes: Base displayed $13/month for first12months; selected contact count not exposed; contact/send overages extra, renewal amount unresolved. Free250-contact plan separate.
Most Popular appears in integration navigation, not a plan card; no explicit plan designation verified.

pricingTiers.name: Premium
pricingTiers.unit: account at base Premium contact selection
pricingTiers.notes: Closest explicitly team-oriented tier: unlimited seats; displayed $350/month for12months at base Premium selection, up to150,000 sends. Contact count/renewal unresolved; volume changes cost.

pricingTiers.name: Custom high-volume plan
pricingTiers.unit: account / negotiated contact and send volume
pricingTiers.notes: Official FAQ directs contact sales above200,000contacts; custom Premium plans above250,000contacts. No flat enterprise amount.

moats.claim: Large integration ecosystem plus accumulated audience history and automation flows creates meaningful migration and configuration switching costs.

productReasons.claim: Marketing automation flows coordinate triggered customer journeys rather than isolated bulk newsletters.
Predictive segmentation and multivariate testing help target and optimize campaigns.
Commerce integrations and dynamic content connect product/customer data to personalized emails.
